 Job Position: Social Media / Content Creator (Graphics & Video)

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Hours: Mon – Sat | 8am – 6pm

	Create engaging graphics and high-quality video content for the company’s social media platforms.
	Plan, shoot, edit, and publish videos that align with the brand’s marketing objectives.
	Design promotional materials, social media posts, banners, flyers, and other digital creatives.
	Develop and manage a monthly content calendar to ensure consistent posting.
	Monitor social media performance, analyze engagement metrics, and recommend content improvements.
	Stay updated with social media trends and create relevant, trend-driven content.
	Collaborate with internal teams to promote products, campaigns, and company activities.

Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree, HND, or relevant certification in Graphic Design, Mass Communication, Marketing, or a related field.
	2–3 years of proven experience in social media management and content creation.
	Proficiency in graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or similar software.
	Strong video shooting and editing skills using Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent.
	Creative mindset with excellent storytelling and visual communication skills.
	Knowledge of social media analytics and content performance tracking.
	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.


Salary
N250,000 / month.

Marketing Executive Job at BAT Computer Technologies Limited




        
    

        
        BAT Computer Technologies Limited is a Technology Systems integration company with vast experience in the Design, Installation and Integration of digital networks, telecommunication systems, and e-business solutions. Licensed by the Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC), to provide telecommunications deployment and installation services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Marketing Executive 

Job Location: Bogije, Ibeju-Lekki - Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time

Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for a results-driven Marketing Executive to drive sales and expand our client base across the telecommunications and ICT sectors.


Responsibilities


	Identify and engage potential clients for our telecom and ICT services.
	Develop and execute marketing strategies to increase brand awareness and new business opportunities.
	Build strong relationships with businesses in need of ICT services.
	Provide feedback and market insight to improve business strategies.


Key Requirements


	2-4 years of proven experience in sales, marketing, or related fields.
	Strong communication and negotiation skills.
	Ability to work independently and meet sales targets.
	Understanding of telecommunications services is a plus.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.    

    

        Click here to Apply
